visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white blazer, sits at a light-colored wooden desk with a laptop and Dove hair care products. She speaks to the camera with a calm facial expression and gestures with her hands. The room is bright with natural-looking indoor lighting and a green plant sits to the left. (2) A second woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans enters the frame, looking shocked with her hands over her mouth as variety text overlays appear. She bows repeatedly to the first woman. (3) The second woman performs a high-energy rap routine, gesturing wildly and pointing at the camera while white variety text overlays appear around her. The interviewer in the white blazer watches from her desk, resting her chin on her hand. (4) A narrative montage sequence occurs showing the second woman acting out various scenes: one where her hair is blowing dramatically in a studio breeze, another where she is kneeling on the floor in a grayscale filter with lightning bolt overlays, appearing to cry. (5) The two women are now seated together on a white sofa. They hold up Dove shampoo bottles and a gold hair mask jar, pointing at the product benefits. Both smile and look directly at the viewer. (6) A split-screen visual comparison appears showing hair textures side-by-side, with the left side labeled as 'Before' showing dry hair and the right side labeled as 'After' showing smooth, shiny hair. (7) The video concludes with a playful sequence of both women on the sofa, laughing and squeezing together in the frame while holding the hair mask jar. The final shot is a white screen with the dark blue Dove logo centered.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear female voice with moderate pitch speaks with a professional, inviting tone over an upbeat acoustic guitar BGM at approximately 120 BPM. The acoustic environment is very clean and dry. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX triggers as a second female voice enters with high vocal arousal and excited prosody, speaking very rapidly. The BGM continues with a bright, positive energy. (3) A loud 'ding' SFX sounds, marking the start of a rhythmic rap sequence by the second female voice. The BGM beat becomes more pronounced, and percussive cartoon-style sound effects punctuate the dialogue. (4) The music shifts to a more dramatic, mock-serious orchestral style with a 'thunder' SFX. The second female voice exhibits dramatic strain and weeping sounds, followed by another 'whoosh' transition. (5) A 'sparkle' chime SFX leads back to the cheerful acoustic BGM. Both female voices interact with moderate volume, exhibiting warm and friendly tones. The sound of a plastic bottle clicking onto a surface is audible. (6) A 'ping' SFX accompanies the mention of product features. The primary female voice maintains a steady, persuasive speech rate while the music remains a consistent background bed. (7) The audio track reaches a peak in event density with overlapping laughter and excited exclamations, concluding with a final brand-themed melodic stinger and a soft chime.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Audition -> Dramatic Demonstration -> Product Feature Highlight -> Final CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Dove's amino acid hair care products through a humorous and engaging 'interview/audition' scenario featuring popular influencers, emphasizing the product's ability to repair 3 years of damage in 7 days.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of product, verbal description of benefits, and visual brand logo overlays throughout.
